contents_tesim: Follows the text of the Old Syriac Gospel; John 1:47 - 2:12 is not otherwise attested in the Old Syriac version; there is a lacuna in both the Curetonianus (British Library, Add. 14451) and Sinaiticus (Sinai Syr. 30) at this point
full_text_tesim: All three UTOs of Sinai Syriac NF M 37 belong to a single Old Syriac Gospel manuscript, to which the four UTOs of Sinai Syriac NF M 39 also belong

Follows the text of the Old Syriac Gospel; John 1:47 - 2:12 is not otherwise attested in the Old Syriac version; there is a lacuna in both the Curetonianus (British Library, Add. 14451) and Sinaiticus (Sinai Syr. 30) at this point
